h: Mexico reportedly clears Reno Omokri as Nigeria's envoy to four countries
p: Mexico has reportedly approved Reno Omokri to serve as Nigeria's ambassador covering four countries in Latin America. The clearance is said to remove the last hurdle before he takes up the post.
more: The approval was reported by a Nigerian news site.
No date has been given for his formal posting.
